entities.name: Alexandru Cantacuzino
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandru Cantacuzino was a Romanian politician from the Cantacuzino family who served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs from 24 June 1862 until 29 September 1862, and as the Minister of Finance from 12 July 1862 until 16 March 1863.
